summary: Iteration 3 testing of (A) client logo upload/get/delete + storage integration and report embedding, and (B) default + per-client alert rules with rule-honoring alert generation. Backend: 20 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter3.py (ALL PASS). Full regression: 84/84 total tests pass across iter1 backend_test.py (40), iter2 test_iter2.py (24), and iter3 test_iter3.py (20). Frontend: Playwright flow confirms Settings page default alert rules UI (all 5 rule checkboxes + min-severity select + save button) persists via /api/settings/alerts; Clients page shows Acme Dental logo thumbnail, Replace/Remove buttons, and Alert rules dialog with default/custom toggle writing to /api/clients/{id}/alert-rules; '(custom)' label appears after saving custom rules and disappears when reverted. Report with Acme Dental client logo: data endpoint returns client_logo_id, DOCX export contains >=2 images in word/media/ (Temprudence + client logo), ODT contains >=2 pictures in Pictures/, PDF export is valid %PDF; reports for unassigned computers correctly omit client_logo_id. Alert generation: with default rules all-on/low -> alert with both software_added and admin_rights items; disabling software_added suppresses app-install items; min_severity=high keeps only admin-granted (high) items; all rules off -> no alert; client custom rules override defaults for scans from that client's key.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 829 lines (previously 699). The 700-line soft threshold is exceeded. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, users, keys, agent, computers, clients+logos, alerts+rules, settings, reports) before adding further features.
storage.py cleanly isolates Emergent Object Storage via /objstore/api/v1/storage with lazy re-init on 404 - good retry semantics.

Logo upload normalizes images to PNG via Pillow (RGBA->RGB on white, 800x800 thumbnail) and enforces 2MB + PNG/JPEG/WEBP whitelist with correct 413/415 responses. Previous logo rows are soft-deleted (is_deleted=True in db.files) when replaced/removed - good audit trail.
GET /api/clients/{id}/logo requires auth (current_user) - correct per spec; returns 404 when missing, Cache-Control: private, max-age=300 - sensible.
load_client_logo swallows storage exceptions and returns None - good for not blowing up report generation, but logs via logger.error.
AlertRules Pydantic model + alert_rules_for(client_id) merging DEFAULT_ALERT_RULES with per-client overrides is clean. change_alerts(rules=...) correctly filters by rule flag AND min_severity floor.

Severity mapping matches spec: software_added=medium, software_removed=low, account added=high, other account changes=medium, admin granted=high, admin removed=medium, security findings use flag severity.
No MongoDB _id leakage detected across all tested endpoints.
ClientLogo.jsx fetches as blob with URL.createObjectURL and revokes on unmount - correct.
AlertRulesForm.jsx is reused across Settings default rules (prefix='default-rules') and ClientRulesDialog (prefix='client-rules') - good DRY.

reports.py _client_logo() scales both DOCX and ODT and PDF covers using the client_logo bytes attached by file_response via load_client_logo(rep['client_logo_id']) - verified 2 images embedded in docx/odt and valid PDF.
